title: Nonzero differential gives derivation
statement: For a field M of characteristic p and f : M with nonzero universal differential over ZMod p, there exists D : Derivation Z M M with D f ≠ 0.

proof.text: Choose a linear functional nonzero on the differential and compose it with the universal derivation.
